changelog: **Company team seats (#1870):** additive `CompanyMembership` (`orgId`, `companyId`, `userId`, `seatRole` OWNER|RECRUITER|HIRING_MANAGER|INTERVIEWER, `@@unique([companyId, userId])`, `TENANT_MODELS`) and `InvitationToken.companySeatRole`; `User.companyId` unchanged, nothing re-keyed. A COMPANY login without a row reads as OWNER (the flat set it always had); backfill `0037-company-memberships` makes those rows explicit (adds only, idempotent) and registration writes the row for every new COMPANY login. Pure rule `companyCan()` in `src/lib/companySeats.ts`; ONE server gate `requireCompanySeat()` (`src/lib/companySeatGate.ts`, `403 insufficient_seat_role`) on requisition writes, application stage moves (single + bulk), interests, interview requests, talent pool (seat AND entitlement), outreach and the company's own profile PUT; `seatScopedActor()` narrows an INTERVIEWER's application reads to its panels' candidates inside `visibleApplicationsWhere()`. `/company/team` (`GET/POST /api/company/team`, `PATCH/DELETE /api/company/team/[userId]`): OWNER-only invite/role/remove, last-owner guard (`409 last_owner`), removal detaches + deactivates + revokes sessions and trusted devices, audited. `Company.quota` is the seat limit (`403 seat_limit_reached` with `limit`/`used`; null = unlimited). The onboarding checklist gains "invite a teammate". `docs/company-team-seats.md`.

en: Companies can now invite their team: owners, recruiters, hiring managers and interviewers each get exactly the access their role needs — interviewers only see the candidates they are meeting.
tr: Şirketler artık ekiplerini davet edebiliyor: sahipler, işe alım uzmanları, işe alım yöneticileri ve mülakatçılar rollerinin gerektirdiği kadar erişim alıyor — mülakatçılar yalnızca görüşecekleri adayları görüyor.
de: Unternehmen können jetzt ihr Team einladen: Inhaber:innen, Recruiter:innen, Hiring Manager:innen und Interviewer:innen erhalten genau den Zugriff, den ihre Rolle braucht – Interviewer:innen sehen nur die Kandidat:innen, die sie treffen.
